summary.zh: 现在多打一会儿，可能换来之后更长的一段无法射击。
summary.en: A little more fire now may force a much longer pause afterward.

rules.zh: 开火持续积累热量，松开后冷却；越过临界点会触发更长停机或其他明确惩罚。玩家观察热量和敌人状态，在主动短停与强行补完最后一击之间取舍。热量管理与弹药管理可以并存。
rules.en: Firing builds heat that falls when the trigger is released. Crossing a threshold causes a longer shutdown or a clear penalty. Watch heat and enemy state to choose a short voluntary pause or a final risky burst; heat may coexist with ammunition limits.

loop.en: Read heat and the current threat
Cool deliberately or risk more fire

loop.zh: 恢复后安排下一段射击
loop.en: Plan the next firing window after recovery

decisions.zh: 敌人只剩少量生命时，是否值得让武器过热来确保击杀？
decisions.en: Is finishing a nearly defeated enemy worth overheating?

decisions.zh: 冷却时换副武器，还是继续保持主武器瞄准等待？
decisions.en: Switch weapons during cooling or keep the primary aimed and wait?

name.zh: 正常冷却与过热停机差距

effect.zh: 差距越大，提前停火越重要；差距太小则很难形成取舍。
effect.en: A larger gap makes early release valuable; little difference weakens the decision.

effect.zh: 声音、颜色和动画共同提示接近过热，让玩家不用一直盯着仪表。
effect.en: Sound, color and animation can warn of heat without requiring constant meter watching.

contrast.zh: 深岩银河把热量与任务弹药储备叠加；Titanfall 2 的 L-STAR 更突出连续交火中的停火节奏。
contrast.en: DRG combines heat with mission ammunition reserves; Titanfall 2’s L-STAR emphasizes trigger pacing during sustained encounters.

combination.zh: 组合提案：塔炮有热量表，提前叫波能多拿资源，但会压缩冷却时间；玩家要看防线剩余火力再决定要不要加速。
combination.en: Design proposal: towers have heat meters, so calling waves early earns resources while reducing cooling time; spare firing capacity becomes part of the call decision.

setup.zh: 热量已到八成，两个敌人还在靠近。
setup.en: Heat is at eighty percent and two enemies are approaching.

action.zh: 玩家先松开扳机，绕过柱子争取冷却。
action.en: The player releases fire and circles a pillar to cool.

result.zh: 热量下降，敌人也绕到了同一侧。
result.en: Heat drops while the enemies move to the same side.

next.zh: 重新开火，并判断这轮能否在过热前结束。
next.en: Fire again and judge whether the encounter can end before overheating.

firstStep.zh: 做一根热量条、正常冷却和过热锁定两种状态，配一个持续接近的靶子。
firstStep.en: Build one heat meter, ordinary cooling, an overheated lockout and one approaching target.

pitfall.zh: 不要让热量条看似线性、实际临界点却无法预测。
pitfall.en: Keep the displayed threshold predictable instead of hiding an unexpected overheat point.

test.zh: 玩家是否会在临界前主动松手，而不是每次都等系统强制停机？
test.en: Do players release before the limit instead of always waiting for forced shutdown?
